scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && npm run electron:build:preload && npm run electron:build:preload:mini
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,MAIN,PRELOAD,PRELOAD_MINI,APP -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx server.ts" "esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --external:say --external:playwright --external:ws --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs --watch" "esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs --watch" "esbuild electron/preload-mini.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload-mini.cjs --watch" "wait-on tcp:3000 dist-electron/main.cjs dist-electron/preload.cjs dist-electron/preload-mini.cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:preview: npm run electron:build && npm run electron:start
